name: Chromatic Dragon, Yellow
body:
LE dragon (earth, fire)

BASE STATISTICS

Subpages

CR 2; Size Tiny; Hit Dice 3d12
Speed 30 ft., burrow 30 ft.
Natural Armor +4; Breath Weapon line, 2d6 sonic
Str 10, Dex 17, Con 12, Int 7, Wis 9, Cha 7

ECOLOGY

Environment temperate and tropical grasslands
Organization solitary
Treasure triple

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Deafening Breath Weapon (Ex)

Those who fail their save against a young or older dragon are permanently deafened.

Improved Blindsight (Ex)

A very young or older yellow dragon can see using sound, even while within a solid object. This ability allows it to discern objects and creatures within 60 feet regardless of terrain or barriers that would normally impede vision. Unlike normal blindsight, a sonic creature does not need line of effect to a creature or object to discern that creature or object. A silence spell negates this ability.

Silence Vulnerability (Ex)

A yellow dragon is considered entangled while within the area of a silence spell. A silence spell also negates all the dragon’s sonic-based attacks within its area. A silence spell cast directly on this dragon does not have a silencing effect on the area or entangling effect on the dragon; instead, it causes the creature to become nauseated for 1 rnd. per CL on a failed save.

Sound Bite (Ex)

An ancient or older yellow dragon’s bite issues a concussive blast of sonic energy when its jaws snap shut. Each time the dragon makes a bite attack, whether it hits or misses, each creature in a 10-footradius burst centered on the attack’s target takes 1d8 points of sonic damage and must succeed at a Reflex save or be stunned for 1 round. A creature that succeeds at this save is immune to the stun effect from additional sonic bites from that dragon until the dragon’s next turn, but it still takes sonic damage from additional sound bites. A great wyrm’s sound bite creates a 20-foot-radius burst and does 2d8 points of sonic damage. The save is the same DC as the dragon’s breath weapon.

Spell-Like Abilities (Sp)

A yellow dragon gains the following spell-like abilities, usable at will upon reaching the listed age category.

Juvenile—clarion call; Adult—shatter; Very Old—disrupt silence; Great wyrm—shout.

Tinnitus (Su)

An adult or older yellow dragon may emit a high pitched hum that may disrupt spellcasting; casting within 20 feet of the dragon requires a concentration check (DC 15 + the level of the spell being cast). All other concentration checks and Perception checks involving hearing made inside the aura have their DCs increased by 5. A yellow dragon can begin or end this ability as a free action. An old yellow dragon’s tinnitus aura extends out 40 feet. An ancient dragon’s aura increases the DC by another 5 points. This is a sonic effect.

Wounding Sound (Su)

When an old or older yellow dragon is wounded, its body involuntarily makes a thunderous report. Anyone within 30 feet of the dragon when it is wounded must make a Fortitude save or take 1d6 points of sonic damage, be stunned for 1 round, and be permanently deafened by the sudden sound blast. A creature that cannot hear or one that makes its save is not deafened or stunned, but it still takes 1d6 points of sonic damage on a failed save. Any unattended object in the area automatically takes 1d6 points of sonic damage each time the dragon makes a wounding sound. The save is the same DC as the dragon’s breath weapon.
